title: Travel agencies
tagline: Ticketing, hotels and visa under one roof
headline: One system for the counter, the phone and the website
intro: Most agencies sell tickets, hotels, visas and tours to the same customers. TravelSuite ERP puts all of it on one screen, with the accounts updating as you work.

seo.keywords: travel agency software, travel agency management system, travel ERP for agencies
overview: TravelSuite ERP is travel agency software that brings flights, hotels, visa processing, tour packages, CRM and accounting into one system. Your team serves walk-in, phone, WhatsApp and website customers from the same screen, and every sale reaches the accounts as it happens.

Each customer has one profile with every booking, payment, document and conversation. Whoever picks up the phone sees the full history, so nobody asks for a passport twice or quotes a different price.
Invoices, receipts, supplier bills and expenses feed the same ledger. Today's sales, outstanding dues and profit are always current, without exporting to separate accounting software.
Agencies in Bangladesh, the UAE, the United Kingdom, Jordan and the USA already run on TravelSuite ERP. Start with the services you sell today and switch on more modules as you grow.
faqs: Is TravelSuite ERP suitable for small agencies?
Yes. Many agencies start with two or three staff. Turn on only the services you sell, and add modules and users as the agency grows.
Which services can we sell?
Flights, hotels, visa processing, tour packages and Hajj & Umrah, alongside CRM, a shared inbox, accounting, HR and task management.
Can we keep our existing customer data?
Yes. We import customers, agents, suppliers and opening balances from Excel during setup.
How long does setup take?
Most agencies go live in 7 to 14 days, including data import and staff training.
Do we get our own website?
Yes. Your website runs on your own domain and shows the services and packages you sell. Enquiries from it go straight into the CRM.
Can we see profit per booking?
Yes. Each booking records the selling price and the supplier cost, so profit is visible per booking and per service.
Which payment methods can we record?
Cash, bank transfer, mobile wallet, card, cheque and others. Each method can be used for receiving money, paying suppliers or both.
Is support available in Bangla?
Yes. Our team supports you in English and Bangla over WhatsApp, phone and email.

title: Hajj & Umrah operators
headline: Every pilgrim, package and payment in one place
intro: Hajj and Umrah seasons bring hundreds of pilgrims, each with documents, visas, rooms and instalments. TravelSuite ERP keeps every file complete and every payment on time.

seo.keywords: Hajj software, Umrah management system, Hajj agency software Bangladesh, Umrah software Malaysia
overview: TravelSuite ERP's Hajj & Umrah module is built for agencies that run Hajj, Umrah and Ramadan Umrah seasons. Build packages, register pilgrims, organise travel groups and record payments in one system instead of spreadsheets.
Each pilgrim file holds the passport, photo, visa and vaccination status, so the operations team sees who is ready to travel and which documents are missing long before departure.

Packages carry their dates, inclusions and seat counts. Sub-agents can sell them, with sales and commission tracked for each agent, and reports show the sales trend, booking status, top packages and commission activity.
Because visas, accounts and the shared inbox are part of the same platform, the season's revenue, dues and profit are always up to date.
faqs: Can we manage Hajj, Umrah and Ramadan Umrah together?
Yes. Every package belongs to a journey, and reports can be filtered by Hajj, Umrah or Ramadan Umrah.
Can we run several groups at once?
Yes. Pilgrims are organised into travel groups for each departure, and each group shows its own document readiness.
Which pilgrim documents can we track?
Passport, photo, visa and vaccination status for every pilgrim, so missing documents surface before departure.
Can sub-agents sell our packages?
Yes. Bookings can be linked to a sub-agent, and their sales and commission appear in the agent reports.
How do we record instalments?
Record each deposit or instalment against the booking by cash, bank transfer or mobile wallet. The outstanding balance updates straight away.
Does it handle Umrah visas?
Yes. Visa applications are tracked stage by stage in the visa module, from document collection to delivery.
Which reports do we get?
Sales trend, booking status mix, top packages by sales and commission activity, filtered by date, journey and agent.
Is it only for agencies in Bangladesh?
No. Hajj and Umrah operators in any country can use it, with multiple currencies and support in English and Bangla.

title: B2B consolidators
headline: Grow your agent network without growing your back office
intro: Consolidators live on volume and credit control. TravelSuite ERP gives every agent a self-service portal while you keep markups, credit limits and balances under control.

seo.keywords: B2B travel portal, travel consolidator software, sub-agent management, agent credit limit software
overview: TravelSuite ERP helps consolidators and wholesalers sell through a network of sub-agents. Agent profiles, agent bookings, commission and payouts are managed in one Agent Management workspace.

Every booking made through an agent records the service, the customer, the sale and the commission, so each agent's earned, paid and available commission is always correct and payouts take minutes, not days.
Commission can be a percentage or a fixed amount per booking, set as a default and changed for individual agents. A performance ranking shows which partners bring the most sales.
Flights, hotels, packages and accounting share the same database, so agent sales flow straight into invoices, ledgers and reports.
faqs: Can I set different commission for each agent?
Yes. Set a default commission as a percentage or a fixed amount per booking, and change it for individual agents.
How are commission payouts recorded?
Commissions & Payouts shows each agent's earned, paid and available amounts. Record a payout and the balance updates.
Can I see which agents perform best?
Yes. Agent Performance ranks agents by bookings and sales.
Which services can agents sell?
Any service you sell in TravelSuite ERP, such as flights, hotels, tour packages, visas and Hajj & Umrah packages.
Do agent sales appear in the accounts?
Yes. Agent bookings, invoices and commission payouts share the same database as accounting, so nothing is entered twice.
Can we bring our existing agents across?
Yes. We import your agent list and opening balances from Excel during setup.
Can our agents be in other countries?
Yes. Agents can be anywhere, and multiple currencies are supported.
How long does setup take?
Most businesses go live in 7 to 14 days, including data import and staff training.

title: Tour operators & DMCs
headline: Design packages once, sell them everywhere
intro: Tour operators juggle itineraries, departures, suppliers and costing. TravelSuite ERP connects them, so every package shows its real margin before you sell a seat.

seo.keywords: tour operator software, DMC software, tour package booking system, itinerary software
overview: TravelSuite ERP is tour operator software for agencies and DMCs. Build tour packages with day-by-day itineraries, specifications, prices and departure rules, and sell them on your website and at the counter.
Each tour has adult, child and infant prices, a price unit and booking rules such as cut-off days, a maximum number of tickets, instant booking or an enquiry form.
Tours can be your own products or a vendor's tours resold on commission. Vendor services, bookings and payables are tracked in Vendor Management, so supplier costs are clear before the trip ends.
Categories, destinations, photos, video, maps, FAQs and SEO fields turn every tour into a page that ranks and sells, while bookings and payments stay in the same system.
faqs: Can I publish tours on my website?
Yes. Each active tour appears on your website with photos, a gallery, video, map, FAQs and its own SEO title and description.
Which tour types are supported?
Private, group, fixed departure and custom tours.
Can I set child and infant prices?
Yes. Set adult, child and infant prices, a compare-at price, an extra charge for private tours and the price unit.
Can I limit the number of seats?
Yes. Set the maximum number of tickets and how many days before travel bookings close.
Can I sell other operators' tours?
Yes. Mark a tour as a vendor's product and track the vendor's payout and your commission.
Can customers book instantly?
Turn on instant booking, an enquiry form, or both, for each tour.
Can I create a custom trip for one customer?
Yes. Create a custom booking for a single customer or company.
Can I organise tours by destination and category?
Yes. Use destinations and categories such as adventure, family, honeymoon, cultural, beach and pilgrimage tours.

title: Online travel agencies

intro: Launch a booking website that looks and works like the big OTAs, with online payment, customer accounts and AI that answers questions around the clock.

Customers browse, book and enquire online, while the same system handles fulfilment, customer service and accounting, so nothing is re-typed after a booking.
Theme, header and footer, media, SEO, analytics and the customer portal are managed from your admin, so you control how the site looks and how it ranks.

Which payment methods can customers use?
You choose which payment methods are shown at checkout, such as bank transfer, mobile wallet or card. Ask our team about online card gateways for your country.
Can customers manage their own bookings?
Yes. The customer portal lets customers see their bookings and details.
Is the booking site mobile friendly?
Yes. Every page is responsive and works on phones, tablets and desktops.
Can I edit the website myself?
Yes. Theme, header and footer, media and SEO settings are managed from the admin, without code.
Does the website help with SEO?
Yes. Each tour and page has its own meta title and description, and analytics can be connected from the settings.
Can the site be in more than one language?
Yes. Translation settings let you offer the website in more than one language.

title: Corporate travel desks
headline: Business travel booked fast, billed correctly and reported clearly
intro: Serve companies whose staff travel often. Every request is assigned, every trip invoiced to the right client, and every client can see what they spent.

seo.keywords: corporate travel management software, business travel booking, travel approval workflow
overview: TravelSuite ERP helps agencies serve corporate clients: companies whose staff travel often and expect bookings to be handled quickly, invoiced correctly and reported clearly.
Company clients and their travellers are kept in the CRM with every booking, invoice and payment, so your account managers see the whole relationship in one place.
Requests become tasks with an owner, a priority and a deadline, so urgent trips are never missed, and the shared inbox keeps every email and WhatsApp message with the client's record.
Invoices and payments are tracked per client, outstanding balances are always visible, and sales reports by service, staff and period help each client understand their travel spend.
faqs: Can we keep each company's travellers together?
Yes. Company clients and their travellers are kept in the CRM, with every booking and invoice.
How do we make sure urgent trips aren't missed?
Each request becomes a task with an owner, a priority and a deadline, and overdue tasks stand out.
Can we invoice companies?
Yes. Invoices are created from bookings, and outstanding balances are tracked per client.
Can clients get spend reports?
Sales reports by service, staff and period can be prepared and shared with each client.
Which services can we book for companies?
Flights, hotels, visas and tour packages, including team trips and events.
Can we handle business and work visas?
Yes. The visa module has workflows and document checklists for business and work visas.
Can several staff work on one client?
Yes. Tasks and bookings can be assigned to different team members, so the whole travel desk sees who handles what.
How long does setup take?
Most agencies go live in 7 to 14 days, including data import and staff training.
